name: search
title: Search with a typed query
shows: A command bar: the query types in, three results with the matches in bold, the selection steps down, keyboard hints at the foot.
edit: The query and results as written come first; opts.queries [{q, rows: [[icon, title, meta]]}] adds more, one per cycle. With none it types its own query again.
loop: about 2.7 s a cycle: the query is typed again, results appear one by one, the selection steps down; the finished picture holds for at most 15% of the cycle; restarts when the pointer enters its card
